title: Reset reaches accept or done without their native prerequisites
symptom: stage reset --to done and --to accept succeeded while the native change was draft
trigger: chough stage reset --to <accept|done> with an unapproved or unarchived change
expected: Reset may move back freely but refuses a destination whose native prerequisites do not hold
actual: Allowed; only reset --to build is gated
steps: Draft native change recorded in the checkpoint
impact: A checkpoint can claim done without acceptance or archival
source: Review finding B, reproduced 2026-10-31 against main f19823d
